note: WDLL 51. Standard-lot baseline rows transcribed from official UDC Table 4-4 at https://ecode360.com/42968563 (Chapter 4, ??4.11.04?.05; accessed 2026-07-23). side_corner_ft mirrors base side only as a non-binding sentinel because the table does not provide a distinct corner-side column; cover values are non-binding sentinels in this extraction. OMITTED: zero-lot-line one-side waivers, PUD mixed-use modifications, Edwards Aquifer controls, MH2 special separation, PARK, and all district variants not represented by a direct standard-lot row. GIS I-1 is deliberately not mapped here until its spelling-to-I1 mapping is reviewed. P-299 OT-1 (height-flag reconciliation, 2026-09-17): every max_height_ft row in this file that carried not_specified was re-read against its own provenance quote and classified with this repo's not_specified-meaning instrument (doc_repo scripts/corpus_not_specified_audit.py, OPS-21-R1). SENTINEL NORMALIZED to the canonical 999 (rule G7) -- the row's own quote states no feet-based limit (stories-only, "none", an absent height subsection, or a placeholder-shaped value in a mixed group), so the flagged number was a placeholder a flag-dropping reader would take for a real height: P Public/Institutional/Civic (100 -> 999). OF THOSE, RECORDED AS RESIDUALLY UNCERTAIN (placeholder-shaped value inside a group of real transcribed values; the value is not quotable in feet from the text read here, so the canonical sentinel is carried rather than a guess -- this is an adjudication, not a re-read at source, and is the first thing to re-check if a limit later surfaces): P Public/Institutional/Civic. FLAG REMOVED, VALUE KEPT -- here the FLAG was the defect and the number was real; not_specified on these rows asserted a false absence. The basis is stated PER ROW because it is not the same for all of them: for these rows the quote names the tabulated height column without restating the number, so the basis is the OPS-21-R1 / P-146 instrument's classification REAL_VALUE_FLAGGED -- the values across that row's flagged siblings are VARIED (transcribed numbers, not one uniform placeholder), which is the discriminator the ruling names (AG Agricultural (keeps 35); SF1 Low Density Residential (keeps 35); SF2 Medium Density Residential (keeps 35); SF3 High Density Residential (keeps 35); TF Duplex Residential (keeps 35); MF1 Multifamily (keeps 35); MF2 Multifamily (keeps 45); MH1 Manufactured Housing (keeps 35); C1 Neighborhood Commercial/Retail (keeps 25); C2 Downtown Commercial/Retail (keeps 45); C3 General Commercial/Retail (keeps 45); I1 Light Industrial (keeps 45); I2 General Industrial (keeps 45)).
